name: P-GROW3 Auto-Optimization Loop
flow: Client: trackTrustGrowthEvent → POST /api/v1/trust-growth/ingest (public allowlist; server requires chain_off + DATABASE_URL / PgPool)
Server: trust_growth_ingest_and_recompute → upsert trust_growth_variant_metrics; refresh trust_growth_runtime_state + trust_growth_generation_history (crates/api/src/db/trust_growth.rs)
Server: autopilot recompute (moments_json, variant caps, autopilot_generation) per trust_growth_autopilot + trust_growth_control
Client: useTrustGrowthExperiment → GET /api/v1/trust-growth/config → pickVariantIdWithWeights(moments from body, autopilot_generation)
notes: Implementation SSOT: docs/spec/04 §3.4 (trust-growth rows); frontend/lib/trustGrowthAnalytics.ts + frontend/lib/api.ts routes.
Narrative only: legacy .data/trust-growth/aggregates.json and runtime-weights.json paths are NOT used by traveltrust-api.
Optional NEXT_PUBLIC_TRUST_GROWTH_SERVICE_URL overrides origin; paths remain /api/v1/trust-growth/*.
Bump trustGrowthExperiments.ts version to reshuffle assignments; autopilot_generation tracks recompute count.
